screen.index_lead: The ratings your account gave, and where each one stands.
screen.index_empty_lead: When your account rates something, the rating shows up in this list.
screen.form_lead: Give one to five stars and, if you like, say what you thought. The rating is published as soon as you send it.
screen.withdraw_lead: The text is erased and the stars stop counting. You can rate again afterwards.
screen.score_hint: Tap the stars to give a score.
screen.under_review_lead: The owner disagreed with this rating and the moderation will decide. It stays published until then and cannot be changed or deleted.
screen.owner_index_lead: The subjects your account owns, with the average and the number of ratings of each.
screen.owner_index_empty_lead: Adjust the search or come back later.
screen.owner_subject_lead: What the accounts said. If you disagree with one, report it with the reason and the moderation decides.
screen.owner_subject_empty_lead: Adjust the search or the filters.
screen.owner_reports_lead: The ratings your account reported and what the moderation decided.
screen.owner_reports_empty_lead: When you report a rating, it shows up in this list.
screen.owner_report_lead: Explain why this rating should not stay published. The moderation reads your reason and decides.
screen.reason_hint: Say what is wrong: an offence, false information, an account that never used the service.
screen.team_index_lead: The reports of every space, oldest first.
screen.team_search: Search by reason, reporter or subject
screen.team_index_empty_lead: Nothing is waiting for a decision. Adjust the search or the filters to see the decided ones.
screen.decide_lead: Remove the rating, correct its text or dismiss the report. The justification is recorded, with who decided and when.
screen.new_body_hint: Only for correcting the text. Take out the offending part and keep the rest.
screen.note_hint: Required. The author reads this justification when the rating is removed or corrected.

validation.score: Choose from one to five stars.
validation.subject: Invalid subject.
validation.too_many: Ask for at most 100 subjects at a time.
validation.verdict: Choose what to do with the report.
validation.score_locked: This moderation does not change the stars, only the text.
validation.rating_removed: The moderation removed your rating of this subject. It cannot be written again.
validation.already_rated: Your account already rated this subject. Change the existing rating.
validation.under_review: This rating is under review and cannot be changed or deleted until the moderation decides.
validation.not_published: Only a published rating can be changed or deleted.
validation.edit_window: The time to change this rating has passed.
validation.not_reportable: Only a published rating can be reported.
validation.already_reported: This rating was already reported and is waiting for the moderation's decision.
validation.rating_changed: The rating is no longer published and does not take that decision.
validation.unchanged: The corrected text is the same as the current one. Change it, or choose another decision.

activity.rating_removed: Rating of :subject removed by the moderation
activity.rating_altered: Rating of :subject corrected by the moderation
activity.rating_report_dismissed: Report on the rating of :subject dismissed
